review.reason: The cited passages support the main technical mappings: Slide 11 links Interface Test and PDN to scopes, and Slide 20 lists SI flow items such as IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram and TDR Impedance, while the limitations about missing bandwidth, model, standards, and pass/fail details are also supported. The main caveat is that the passages frame these as test/validation contexts and R&S target areas, not explicitly as 'Semiconductor market requirements,' but the answer mostly handles this cautiously and does not invent detailed oscilloscope specifications.
